## built-ins

what a note is written with

### `coalesce(values: Value...)`

returns Value

Return the first non-null value.

`coalesce(null, 1)`

### `completed(checklist: Checklist)`

returns Count

Count completed leaf tasks beneath a named heading.

`completed(checklist)`

### `countdown(duration: Duration, elapsed?: Duration, started?: DateTime)`

returns Countdown

An idle countdown. Use Start timer to capture a timestamp; elapsed and started are persisted by timer controls.

`countdown(25m)`

### `date(value: Text, Date, or DateTime)`

returns Date or DateTime

Parse ISO or relative date text, or take a timestamp's calendar date in the request timezone.

`date("next Friday")`

### `debug(value: Value)`

returns Text

Inspect any value as compact JSON text in an inlay. Records, lists, and host objects expose their fields; money, dates, durations, and ratios keep their type and units.

`debug({rain: 35%, pack: true})`

### `effort(checklist: Checklist)`

returns Duration

Sum estimates of unfinished leaf tasks beneath a named heading.

`effort(checklist)`

### `forecast(place: Text, date: Date, unit?: F or C)`

returns Forecast

The cached forecast for a place and day, with .high, .low, .summary and .rain. Beyond 16 days, returns a seasonal outlook for up to about 7 months, labeled as an estimate. Seasonal .rain is the fraction of available ensemble runs with more than 0.1 mm of daily precipitation (including snow); it is unavailable with fewer than two valid runs. Itinerary days with a place get one automatically.

`forecast("Oaxaca", 2026-11-20)`

### `forecast_range(place: Text, start: Date, end: Date, unit?: F or C)`

returns List

Cached daily forecasts in chronological order, including both dates. Project .high, .low, or .rain and pass the list to sparkline. One refresh requests the entire interval. Dates beyond 16 days use seasonal estimates; missing days remain lookup warnings until available. Limited to 4096 days.

`forecast_range("Oaxaca", 2026-11-20, 2026-11-26, F)`

### `if(condition: Boolean, then: Value, else: Value)`

returns Value

Evaluate only the selected branch; more condition, result pairs may come before the else.

`if(n < 0, "negative", n == 0, "zero", "positive")`

### `import(id: Text)`

returns Record

Load a module by ID, or a note by path such as import("./values.x.md"); members keep their own source.

`import("format")`

### `let(names: Record, body: Value)`

returns Value

Name values for the body; each name can use the ones before it.

`let({x: 2, y: x * 3}, x + y)`

### `match(value: Value, case: Value, result: Value, otherwise: Value)`

returns Value

Pick the result of the first case equal to the value, else the last argument; more case, result pairs may follow the first.

`match(state, "open", "○", "done", "✓", "?")`

### `maximize(objective: linear expression)`

returns Plan

Declare a linear plan over the | constraint | expression | table below; undefined names become decisions.

`maximize(3 * bagels + 1.25 * doughnuts)`

### `minimize(objective: linear expression)`

returns Plan

Like maximize, but finds the smallest objective that satisfies every constraint in the table below.

`minimize(cost)`

### `now()`

returns DateTime

The current timestamp. Sampled once per evaluation; live hints refresh every second.

`now()`

### `quote(symbol: ticker code)`

returns Money

The cached last price for a ticker, e.g. quote(NVDA); non-US tickers need a provider in .xmd/providers.json.

`quote(NVDA)`

### `rate(from: currency code, to: currency code)`

returns Number

The cached exchange rate between two currencies, e.g. rate(EUR, USD). Refresh with xmd refresh or the ⟳ lookups lens; hovers show the age.

`rate(EUR, USD)`

### `remaining(checklist: Checklist)`

returns Count

Count unfinished leaf tasks beneath a named heading.

`remaining(checklist)`

### `solve(constraint: expression with <=, >=, or ==)`

returns Number, Money, or Duration

Goal seek: the definition's own name is the unknown, set to the boundary value that makes the constraint hold.

`solve(total >= $500)`

### `sparkline(values: List, min?: Number, Money, Ratio, or Duration, max?: Number, Money, Ratio, or Duration)`

returns Text

Draw one Unicode bar per numeric value, in list order. Null leaves a gap (·). The scale uses the data's minimum and maximum unless both bounds are supplied; values outside fixed bounds are clipped. Values and bounds must use matching units.

`sparkline([12, 18, 9, 24])`

### `stopwatch(elapsed?: Duration, started?: DateTime)`

returns Stopwatch

An idle stopwatch. Use Start, Pause, Resume, or Reset timer. Elapsed time includes time while the editor is closed.

`stopwatch()`

### `sum(items: List or Table, expression?: row calculation)`

returns Number, Money, Ratio, or Duration

Add compatible quantities from a list, skipping nulls, or a row expression over each table row, keeping units.

`sum(groceries, quantity * price)`

### `to(amount: Money, currency: code)`

returns Money

Convert money with the cached rate, e.g. to(hotel, USD); without one the note warns until xmd refresh.

`to(hotel, USD)`

### `today()`

returns Date

The current local calendar date. Updates at midnight.

`today()`

### `total(checklist: Checklist)`

returns Count

Count all leaf tasks beneath a named heading.

`total(checklist)`

## toolkit

the list and text plumbing a note reaches for once it needs it

### `concat(lists: List...)`

returns List

Concatenate lists.

`concat([1, 2], [3])`

### `contains(value: List or Text, part: Value)`

returns Boolean

Test membership or a text substring.

`contains("hello", "ell")`

### `desc(key: Function)`

returns Record

Sort by a key descending, as a sort_by key.

`desc(.due)`

### `ends_with(text: Text, suffix: Text)`

returns Boolean

Test a text suffix.

`ends_with("hello", "lo")`

### `entries(record: Record)`

returns List

List key/value pairs in key order.

`entries({x: 1})`

### `filter(items: List, predicate: Function)`

returns List

Keep items whose predicate returns true.

`filter([1, 2], fn(x) => x > 1)`

### `floor(number: Number)`

returns Number

Round down to an integer.

`floor(1.5)`

### `fold(items: List, initial: Value, function: Function)`

returns Value

Combine items left to right with an accumulator.

`fold([1, 2], 0, fn(a, x) => a + x)`

### `get(collection: Record or List, key: Text or Number)`

returns Value

Read a field or index; return null when absent.

`get({name: "hello"}, "name")`

### `group_by(items: List, key: Function)`

returns List

Group by a scalar key into {key, rows} records, in first-seen order.

`group_by([1, 2, 1], fn(x) => x)`

### `join(items: List, separator: Text)`

returns Text

Join a list of text.

`join(["a", "b"], "/")`

### `length(value: List, Record, or Text)`

returns Count

Count items, fields, or Unicode characters.

`length("hello")`

### `lower(text: Text)`

returns Text

Convert text to lowercase.

`lower("Hello")`

### `map(items: List, function: Function)`

returns List

Apply a pure function to every item.

`map([1, 2], fn(x) => x * 2)`

### `number(value: Number, Money, Ratio, Duration or Count)`

returns Number

Extract the numeric magnitude; durations use seconds.

`number(90m)`

### `object(entries: List)`

returns Record

Build a record from key/value pairs; duplicate keys are rejected.

`object([{key: "x", value: 1}])`

### `pad_end(text: Text, width: Number, fill: Text)`

returns Text

Pad text on the right.

`pad_end("x", 3, " ")`

### `pad_start(text: Text, width: Number, fill: Text)`

returns Text

Pad text to a character width with one character.

`pad_start("3", 2, "0")`

### `repeat(text: Text, count: Number)`

returns Text

Repeat text a bounded number of times.

`repeat("█", 3)`

### `replace(text: Text, from: Text, to: Text)`

returns Text

Replace text occurrences.

`replace("hello", "h", "j")`

### `round(number: Number)`

returns Number

Round to the nearest integer.

`round(1.5)`

### `slice(value: Text or List, start: Number, end: Number)`

returns Text or List

Take a half-open range; text indices count Unicode characters.

`slice("hello", 0, 2)`

### `sort_by(items: List, key: Function, desc(key), or a list of them)`

returns List

Stable sort by one key, or by several in order; desc(key) sorts that key descending. Nulls come last either way.

`sort_by(tasks, [desc(.due), .title])`

### `source(value: Any)`

returns Text

Format a typed scalar as a round-trippable expression.

`source(now())`

### `split(text: Text, separator: Text)`

returns List

Split text into pieces.

`split("a/b", "/")`

### `starts_with(text: Text, prefix: Text)`

returns Boolean

Test a text prefix.

`starts_with("hello", "he")`

### `text(value: Value)`

returns Text

Format a value as text; null remains null.

`text($25)`

### `trim(text: Text)`

returns Text

Remove surrounding whitespace.

`trim(" hello ")`

### `type(value: Any)`

returns Text

Get the runtime type name.

`type(42)`

### `upper(text: Text)`

returns Text

Convert text to uppercase.

`upper("Hello")`

## task attributes

written after a task, like `- [ ] Pack @due(tomorrow)`

### `@after(dependency: Boolean or Checklist, more dependencies...)`

Block this task until all dependencies are satisfied. Cycles are reported with source locations.

`@after(task_name)`

### `@at(time: Date or DateTime)`

Appointment time. Include an explicit UTC offset for ambiguous local times.

`@at(2026-09-18T14:00-04:00)`

### `@due(date: Date or DateTime)`

Deadline. Accepts a named date, an expression, or relative input such as tomorrow. Use Freeze relative date to capture it.

`@due(tomorrow)`

### `@estimate(effort: Duration)`

A nonnegative estimate. Examples: 30s, 20m, 2h.

`@estimate(20m)`

### `@every(interval: recurrence)`

Repeat a leaf task: day, week, month, year, or a positive whole-day duration such as 2w.

`@every(week)`

### `@scheduled(date: Date or DateTime)`

Planned work date; separate from the deadline.

`@scheduled(tomorrow)`

### `@tag(tag: name)`

Tag a task for filtering. Multiple tags may be comma-separated.

`@tag(errands)`

### `@timer(timer: Timer)`

Associate a named timer with this task. Completion does not stop the timer.

`@timer(focus)`

## module built-ins

only `.xmd` module code can call these

### `at_time(date: Date, time: Duration, offset: DateTime)`

returns DateTime

Combine a date and time of day using the reference timestamp offset.

`at_time(today(), 9h, now())`

### `date_parts(date: Date or DateTime)`

returns Record

Read year, month, day and weekday (Monday is zero).

`date_parts(today())`

### `duration_parts(duration: Duration)`

returns Record

Split integer seconds into total hours, remaining minutes and seconds without rounding.

`duration_parts(90m)`

### `error(message: Text)`

returns Never

Return an evaluation error.

`error("Missing data")`

### `eval(expression: Text)`

returns Value

Evaluate expression text in the current document's scope.

`eval("price * 2")`

### `format_date(date: Date or DateTime, format: Text)`

returns Text

Format a date or timestamp with strftime directives.

`format_date(today(), "%Y-%m-%d")`

### `make_date(year: Number, month: Number, day: Number)`

returns Date or Null

Construct a calendar date; invalid dates return null.

`make_date(2026, 9, 18)`

### `merge3(base: Text, ours: Text, theirs: Text)`

returns Record

Merge two edits of a common base line by line: {clean, text}, with conflict markers when both changed the same lines.

`merge3(base, ours, theirs)`

### `parse_date(text: Text, format: Text)`

returns Date or Null

Parse a calendar date with a strftime format; invalid input returns null.

`parse_date("2026-09-18", "%F")`

### `parse_datetime(text: Text, format: Text, offset: DateTime)`

returns DateTime or Null

Parse a local timestamp using a reference timestamp's offset.

`parse_datetime("2026-09-18 09:30", "%F %H:%M", now())`

### `parse_duration(text: Text)`

returns Duration or Null

Parse a written duration.

`parse_duration("2h")`

### `parse_time(text: Text, format: Text)`

returns Duration or Null

Parse a time of day as seconds since midnight.

`parse_time("09:30", "%H:%M")`

### `solve_linear(model: Record)`

returns Record

Solve a bounded linear model and return raw numeric values and status.

`solve_linear(model)`

### `url_encode(text: Text)`

returns Text

Percent-encode text for a URL query or path segment, spaces as +.

`url_encode("New York")`
